WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.o_orderpriority AS priority,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) AS month,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        priority,
        month,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue,
        revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY month) AS mom_change,
        ROUND(
            (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY month)) / 
            NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 2
        ) AS mom_pct_change
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    priority,
    month,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(prev_month_revenue, 2) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND(mom_change, 2) AS mom_change,
    mom_pct_change
FROM ranked
WHERE prev_month_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_pct_change) DESC
LIMIT 20
